value.rationale: Physical excursion duration is a primary observable in switched linear oscillators and enters period and timing-sensitivity calculations. Complete curvature topology on the entire unbounded incoming section is a sharp structural result: trace <=0 implies concavity, while positive trace admits exactly one transition, excluding additional extrema of flight-time sensitivity. Unlike merely differentiating a closed form at a point, the result proves uniqueness uniformly over the full focus family and separates time geometry from spatial-map geometry.
